result.reason: The redline includes the fallback durations, services standard, and remedy menu, but it does not fully reach the fallback because software conformance is qualified by “in all material respects.” It also falls short of the preferred durations and omits compliance-with-laws and malicious-code warranties. The existing Year 2000 warranty and disclaimer remain operative, but the supplier-controlled and potentially exclusive remedy formulation adds a restriction not required by either stated position.
